text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Casino-san, you're seriously amazing at 
presentations, right? Have you always been 
that good?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder. I don't feel like I was 
particularly good at it, though."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Back when I had just arrived in Japan, I 
didn't have any backing or anything, you 
see.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
To achieve what I wanted under those 
circumstances, presentation skills were 
essential. Once you understand that, it'll 
naturally become second nature to you.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Oho... Being able to calculate your 'will' 
and 'can' with high precision just through 
self-analysis is quite a strength~.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
It's easy to sort out "what you can do," 
but "what you're bad at" is hard to admit, 
right? Just being able to do that is 
already a huge plus☆

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. To receive such praise... It seems 
my judgment back then was indeed correct.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Casino-san. When I do something big 
someday, I'll call you up, so wanna join 
in? Big enough to flip common sense upside 
down♪

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
You need my strength, you say? You hold me 
in such high regard...?!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Yep♪ Besides, ambition? Passion? ...Being 
around someone with that kind of vibe is 
always super exciting☆

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Oh... That's one more thing to look 
forward to in the future. If we're gonna 
do it, I want it to be something that 
takes the whole world by surprise!"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
If you're going to make your dreams come 
true, be aggressively confident! Looks 
like some truly excellent days are waiting 
for you!
